description: You are a Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation physician evaluating a patient with chronic joint pain and limited mobility. The patient has had both a CT scan and an MRI of the affected region, and you need to correlate bony and soft tissue findings before formulating a rehabilitation plan. Using Weasis, open the CT series from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_ct/ AND the MRI series from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/pmr_mri/ simultaneously. Configure a side-by-side layout (two panels) so both series are displayed at the same time. Apply the appropriate window and level settings for each modality: bone window for the CT (to evaluate cortical structure) and soft tissue settings for the MRI. On the CT side, place a line measurement across a bony structure of interest. On the MRI side, place a line measurement across the corresponding soft tissue region. Export the side-by-side comparison view as a PNG to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/comparison_view.png. Finally, write a brief correlation report to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/comparison_report.txt documenting the two measurements (CT measurement in mm, MRI measurement in mm) and your clinical correlation.

metadata.clinical_scenario: Multimodality CT+MRI correlation for joint pain assessment
